newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Kinetic Concepts options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Kinetic Concepts options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Thursday it would list options on shares of Kinetic Concepts Inc on February 25.
The exchange said the options would open with strike prices of 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2. The stock was down 5/8 at 14-3/8 Thursday afternoon.
Position limits for the options have been set at 4,500 contracts. Initial expirations will be in March, April, May and August.
Group One Ltd has been named the specialist unit. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
